name: tea-cher
description: Tea-cher: OCR A Level Law case revision, by No-Tea Studio. React + Vite, prerendered to static HTML.

scripts.build: npm run data && tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run build && node scripts/check-site.mjs
